BiblicalUsage: The word is exaltation, a lifting up, and its two uses are the two directions of pride: David ascribes the greatness and the majesty to the LORD, and Adonijah exalts himself, saying, I will be king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the contrast is the whole story: God is exalted because He is God, and the man who exalts himself is brought low.
